name: viro-press
description: VIRO Press — Photoshop/InDesign-class design OS. Compositor is Skia (CanvasKit), type is HarfBuzz, colour is LittleCMS. Not Canvas2D. Not Canva.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm run test:engines && npm run test:unit && npm run test:chrome && npm run test:slices
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./tests/ts-register.mjs --test tests/transform.test.mjs tests/image-fit.test.mjs tests/text-model.test.mjs tests/command-bus.test.mjs tests/anchor-command.test.mjs tests/ui-commands.test.mjs tests/flags.test.mjs tests/effects.test.mjs tests/align.test.mjs tests/stroke-style.test.mjs tests/multi-transform.test.mjs tests/boolean-ops.test.mjs tests/enhance.test.mjs tests/font-catalog.test.mjs tests/auth.test.mjs tests/shapes.test.mjs tests/workflows.test.mjs
